title: SharePoint: Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet to delete brand font files
summary: The deletion commands, visibility control and licensing statements are supported, and the dates and availability match the roadmap. Microsoft documents the fallback for pages, but the briefing extends it to Viva Connections experiences without an explicit supporting passage. Package inspection and editing recommendations also lack corresponding controls-table rows.

claims.claim: SharePoint is introducing Remove-SPOFontFile to delete files from the Brand Fonts library used by the SharePoint brand center.
claims.quote: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing PowerShell support for deleting brand font files from the Brand Fonts library used by the SharePoint Brand Center.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The roadmap says SharePoint administrators can remove fonts that are no longer approved, licensed or needed.
claims.quote: With the new Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet, SharePoint administrators can remove brand font files that are no longer approved, licensed, or needed across their organization in SharePoint.

claims.claim: Learn already documents Remove-SPOFontFile in the Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell module.
claims.quote:
Remove-SPOFontFile
Module: Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell Module
Removes a SharePoint brand font file from the tenant's brand fonts library.

claims.claim: Remove-SPOFontFile -Name <font file name> deletes the named custom brand font file.
claims.quote:
Remove-SPOFontFile -Name "Tahoma.ttf"
This example removes the SharePoint brand font file "Tahoma.ttf" from the brand fonts library across all geo locations.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the cmdlet's tenant default or what happens on arrival.

claims.claim: No source describes the deletion running without an administrator calling the cmdlet.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint Remove-SPOFontFile default automatic rollout enabled admin role; Remove-SPOFontFile default enable. Read roadmap, cmdlet reference and Brand Fonts; deletion is described as a command to run, not an automatic rollout action.

claims.claim: The SharePoint Online Management Shell connection instructions use a SharePoint administrator account.
claims.quote: type the account name and password for a SharePoint administrator account, and then click Sign in.

claims.claim: An admin UI for deleting a brand font file across all geos is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint brand font file delete user interface Brand Fonts library delete Visible Set-SPOFontFile PowerShell REST visibility. Read Brand Fonts, brand-center-overview and Remove-SPOFontFile; no all-geo deletion UI was documented.

claims.claim: SharePoint brand center app > Brand Fonts library > font file > Visible reaches the font availability control.
claims.quote:
navigate to the Brand Fonts library in the Brand center app.
1. Select your custom font file from the library.
2. Edit the Visible property on your font file to control the availability of the font for experiences.

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Editing Visible controls a font's availability for selection without deleting its file.
claims.quote:
Edit the Visible property on your font file to control the availability of the font for experiences.
To remove a custom font file from the tenant's brand fonts library across all geo locations, use Remove-SPOFontFile.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no automation operation for the font file's Visible property at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint font file Visible PowerShell REST Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell; SharePoint brand font file delete user interface Visible Set-SPOFontFile. Read Brand Fonts and module reference excerpts; package IsHidden is not font-file Visible.

claims.claim: Remove-SPOFontPackage -Identity <font package GUID> removes the identified tenant custom font package.
claims.quote:
Remove-SPOFontPackage -Identity 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012
This example removes the font package with the specified GUID.

claims.claim: An admin UI for deleting a brand font package is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint font package delete brand center app Remove-SPOFontPackage. Read Font packages, brand-center-overview and Remove-SPOFontPackage; the app cannot delete packages and no alternate deletion UI was found.

claims.claim: Get-SPOFontPackage retrieves custom tenant font packages for inspection.

Get-SPOFontPackage

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Published brand font files are stored publicly in the cloud.
claims.quote: The newly created font catalog files are publicly stored, along with the fonts, in the cloud

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Publishing brand fonts creates a publicly stored font catalog.
claims.quote: By using this feature and publishing font files, a font catalog is created. The newly created font catalog files are publicly stored, along with the fonts, in the cloud

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The public font and catalog files are accessible to anyone with their URLs, including outsiders.
claims.quote: The files are accessible to anyone, even people outside of your organization, who can get the URLs that link to them.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises against using brand fonts when font licences restrict cloud hosting.
claims.quote: Don't use this feature if your fonts contain proprietary information, or if they have license usage restrictions, such as restrictions on cloud hosting

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing model is included under the existing SharePoint entitlement, which requires users to have an assigned licence including SharePoint.
claims.quote: To access SharePoint, users in your organization need to be assigned a license that includes SharePoint.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No licence specific to Remove-SPOFontFile is published in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint Remove-SPOFontFile licensing price meter Brand center licence; SharePoint brand center license meter pricing. Read Remove-SPOFontFile, Brand Fonts, brand-center-overview and SharePoint service description; no deletion-specific licence found.

claims.claim: The cmdlet and Brand Fonts documentation publish no meter for removing a brand font file.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint Remove-SPOFontFile licensing price meter; SharePoint brand center license meter pricing. Read Remove-SPOFontFile and Brand Fonts; search excerpts describe document processing and Embedded meters, not brand font deletion.

claims.claim: The brand center overview names no licence for the brand center itself.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint brand center license meter pricing. Read brand-center-overview in full: it names E3/E5 for organization fonts in PowerPoint for the web, not for the brand center itself.

For fonts obtained elsewhere or supplied with other apps, you'll need to review the license agreements that accompany those applications.
Microsoft can't provide guidance to fonts that we didn't supply.
